rationale: blk_rst_n comes from the black-box reset mux rstmux_cell. Whether switching sel_q between the two synchronised resets is glitch-free cannot be decided without the cell.

author_reading.rationale: rstmux_cell is an unmodelled library cell; whether its output and select path are glitch-free cannot be decided from the RTL, and a reviewed model is required.

labels.rationale: blk_rst_n is the output of an opaque rstmux_cell that selects between two synchronised resets with a register select. Glitch freedom and select timing inside the cell cannot be decided from RTL.
labels.detection_gap: The mux is an opaque cell, so RDC-009 cannot see its internal logic.

labels.rationale: Switching behavior depends on the omitted mux and its glitch guarantees. The input release chains do not specify how the selected reset reaches blk_q.
labels.suspected_flaw: The cell is defined as an empty module without a black-box attribute. Its output is undriven in the literal RTL.

settlement.rationale: Final equals A. The settler added (* black_box *) to rstmux_cell on line 3, fixing B's undriven-module flaw. B's RDC-013 is run-level and RDC-011 is incidental.
